text:
emma.marketing: Hey team — first draft of the product launch blog is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft (please review the benchmark callouts + webinar CTA). Looking for quick reactions by EOD so we can queue for design and legal.

rajesh.prodmark: skimmed — nice flow. Suggest we tighten the hero claim. Instead of 'cuts inference costs dramatically' maybe 'reduces per-token inference costs by up to 40% on typical RP workloads' if we can justify the number.

lina.content: Agree with rajesh. Also move the benchmark snapshot higher (under hero) with a one-line callout. Readers don't want to dig to the bottom for the numbers.

emma.marketing: Good catch. The core eval says ~35–42% depending on batch/seq; natalie, can legal quickpass the revised phrasing? I'm going to propose: 'reduces per-token inference costs by up to ~40% for common batch/latency profiles'.

natalie.legal: Quickpass: fine with the softening (~40% + "for common batch/latency profiles"). Need a footnote in the blog linking to the benchmark appendix with methodology and dates. Also remove any implication of guaranteed savings — use 'can reduce' rather than 'reduces' if you want to be extra safe.

sam.growth: On the CTA/webinar mapping: we should map registrants to: utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=launch_q2, utm_medium=post. Also want an inbound lead tag: 'launch_interest' on form submission so sales can triage. Can we add 3 registration tiers in the form? (attend, watch recording, case-study interest)

emma.marketing: Good — adding UTM snippet to the CTA link and tagging form fields. Draft UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2` 

emma.marketing: Draft snippet for hero + benchmark callout: 
> Hero: Meet Redwood Inference — predictable, high-performance LLM serving.
> Callout: In our benchmark suite (real app traces, 1–2k requests/s), Redwood Optimize configurations can cut per-token inference cost by up to ~40% vs. baseline single-instance serving.*

emma.marketing: Adding legal footnote placeholder: "*Benchmarks run on internal workloads; results may vary. See appendix for methodology and config."

natalie.legal: That footnote language works. Also please avoid naming competitor X in a comparative sentence unless you can cite a public benchmark; otherwise say 'baseline single-instance serving'.

rajesh.prodmark: For the webinar CTA copy — try: 'Register for the launch webinar: live demo + setup checklist + cost playbook.' Keeps it benefit-forward.

lina.content: Tiny copy edits: change 'setup checklist' to 'deployment checklist' and add a 2-line bulleted 'What you'll learn' under CTA.

emma.marketing: Updated the doc with those edits. Pasting final CTA block here for quick +1s: 
[Register for the launch webinar](/events/launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2)
What you'll learn:
- How Redwood reduces unit inference cost in production
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated and Private options
- Live demo + Q&A with product team

publish-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish window closes in 48h. Please confirm final approvals.

sam.growth: +1 on UTMs and lead tag. Will set form to include 'launch_interest' and tier options. I can wire up HubSpot mapping after publish.

emma.marketing: Natalie / Rajesh / Lina — final approvals? If I hear no objections by 4pm PT I'll lock content and ping design for final assets.

natalie.legal: Approved with footnote and wording tweaks above.

rajesh.prodmark: Approved. Small nits fixed in the doc.

lina.content: Approved from content side. Done.

emma.marketing: Fantastic — thanks all :tada: I'll lock and schedule design handoff.

sam.growth: Nice work team :rocket:
